import struct

for L in [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,100,128,256,512,1000,2000,10000]:
    data=struct.pack('<HBI',23,0x97,L)+b'\x00'*L+struct.pack('<I',0xffffffff)
    open(f'/workspace/poc_var_dv_{L}','wb').write(data)
    print(L,len(data),data[:16].hex())
PY
